reviews.review:
10/10 war first person shooter.
Look at it as a modern day war simulator and not a game.
I was a huge fan of ARMA 2 until ARMA 3 came out.
For some reason arma 2 required a lot to play it in a decent resolution.
They fixed that with arma 3, everything is more fluid and beautiful.

I don't know why it took this long for me to review one of my favorite games but lets go.


To put it simply Arma 3 is one of the best Military sim games out there, some may even say a masterpiece. It might not be the most complex in some aspects, but dam does it create one of the most fun sandboxes I have ever played. If you don't have the game, get it now and hop into the fun. Sure the player-base has decreased over the years, but when a somewhat niche game turns 10 years old that is what is likely going to happen. 

Now before you buy I must say even after 10 years, this game still runs like complete dog s***. I am lucky to get 40 FPS on some scenarios/servers because of the about of entities and physics streaming the game is doing in the background. Super high end computers may be brought to their knees playing this optimized hell fest but that is just how Arma 3 is.

 For a 2013 game, it looks fantastic, its gameplay is fantastic and it has one of the best soundtracks in a game that I have played to date (The "This is war" suite is one of my favorite). The campaign, oh where do I start! You wouldn't except a great campaign but dam is it good story. Its a little janky at times but overall it's a great story with memorable moments and characters. 

Finally, the mods. Oh boy is there mods for this game. Just go to the community tab, type in Arma 3 and go to the workshop. Odds are you can type just about anything into the search bar and find a mod for it. If I really wanted to continue talking about mods I would probably hit a character limit on this review.

Arma 3 is a very special game to me. I started playing this game a month after its official release in 2013 and I still play it to this day. I think I speak for the community on this one when I say that we are all eagerly waiting for BI to release Arma 4.  As of now, all we can do is play the amazing game we have whilst we wait for the next beast in the Arma franchise,
Awesome game, worth every penny. Good single player even better online multiplayer especially if you have a group online. Loads of servers all bring different maps, mods and gaming experience.

I HAV BEEN IN WAR
THIS IS AQURATE SIM
PLS BUY
SUPPORT DEVVS
